text.tspan: Fertility rate vs. GDP per capita 1950 to 2023
The total fertility rate summarizes the total number of births a woman would have, if she experienced the birth
rates seen in women of each age group in one particular year across her childbearing years. This is shown
against gross domestic product (GDP) per capita, adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between
Average annual change in GDP per capita
Average annual change in births per woman

tspan.tspan: UN, World Population Prospects (2024); Feenstra et al. - Penn World Table (2025)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices, using multiple benchmark years to adjust for differences in living costs
